versions.changelog:
- Initial release of stack-mode, enabling commands to operate across multiple dependent PRs in base-to-tip order.
- Supports `/pr-review --stack` and `/fix-pr --stack` workflows, iterating command logic through all PRs in a detected stack.
- Includes multiple strategies to detect PR stacks via branch naming, stack summary comments, or base-chain walks.
- Adds hooks for progress tracking and ensures per-PR workflows and summaries remain unchanged, while posting a consolidated root summary.
- Auto-detects stack membership and prompts users when applicable; otherwise, respects explicit `--stack` command flag.
